en: Black-and-white vintage postcard view taken from under a large brick viaduct arch, looking onto a broad tree‑lined street with people walking. In the background rises a tall church tower above the surrounding buildings. Printed captions identify the scene as a viaduct in Nijmegen. Marginal text at the left names the editor/publisher from Amsterdam, and there is a handwritten-style signature at the bottom right.
